scope: Own exact-remaining quoted cash in prospective PAPER entry-gate research, including its entry/exit FX and downstream cohort/manifest consumers. No live execution, active operator model/policy or environment activation.
implementation: New original plans predeclare paper_exact_cash_mark_v1. Existing incompatible plans are preserved without relabelling or appending; exit identity pins normalized source for the actual financial helpers as well as the existing exit engine.

The virtual entry remains exactly 0.1 SOL. The original typed SOL/USD observation, actual pre-await quote-start clock and checked public entry quote are retained. Original registration and plan must remain unchanged across awaits; cached quotes predating the request are rejected.

One common virtual position remains shared by the gate comparison arms. Its cash owner derives from the original case and normalized frozen runner policy; the financial engine cannot confuse it with another case or an actual SQL position.

Raw market spot can no longer generate financial peaks or price-driven exit intents. Actual tick requests exact remaining-quantity valuations with original typed FX. Original remaining-leg and whole-trade net cash peaks and the checked financial decision context reuse the shared runner cash engine. Independent no-price time and liquidity safeguards remain available.

Pending fills have priority, followed by the oldest cash valuations. The existing shared one-extra-quote-per-minute budget and runner alternation are preserved. A valuation can create an intent but cannot fill it with the already-received quote; a separate later exact-size quote is mandatory.

Valuation generation, original registration, entry prefix and original plan/configuration are rechecked after provider waits. Provider/FX/size/chronology faults stay unknown and do not create a zero-return financial outcome.

New entry-gate exit fills require the original typed FX, matching the scalar at the original fill clock. The shared receipt engine stores and historically rechecks that FX when present; legacy runner fills remain accounting-only and are not retroactively upgraded.

Entry-gate financial cohort acceptance and checked manifest replay require original entry FX/quote chronology, the declared cash contract, frozen policy equality, independent original owned cash coverage, original financial decision marks except explicit timeout/liquidity safeguards, and conserved cash/receipt replay. Legacy data and active selections are not rewritten.
